name: Food Delivery Design Tokens
description: Production-ready normalized design tokens for Food Delivery & Live Tracking mobile application, compliant with WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA and Figma Tokens.

primary.$description: Primary brand CTA, interactive icon color, live tracking highlight (4.85:1 contrast vs white).

hover.$description: Brand hover and pressed state (6.20:1 contrast vs white, WCAG AAA).

subtle.$description: Subtle brand surface tint for badges, tags, and active highlights.

canvas.$description: App canvas background color in light mode.

canvas-dark.$description: Dark canvas background for stage preview and dark mode.

card.$description: Elevated card surface, modal cards, and bottom sheet containers.

muted.$description: Muted surface background for category items and inputs.

subtle.$description: Subtle surface background for pill chips.

primary.$description: High-emphasis text for headings and primary titles (14.2:1 contrast, AAA).

secondary.$description: Medium-emphasis text for body copy and metadata (7.1:1 contrast, AAA).

muted.$description: Tertiary/muted text for captions and helper notes (4.54:1 contrast, AA).

inverse.$description: Inverse text for dark backgrounds and primary CTAs.

brand.$description: Brand colored text with guaranteed AAA contrast against white.

strong.$description: Stronger border stroke for active input boundaries.

success.$description: Positive status, on-time badge, completed order steps (5.1:1 contrast, AA).

success-subtle.$description: Background surface tint for success badges.

warning.$description: Warning status, delivery delay chip, traffic alert (4.7:1 contrast, AA).

warning-subtle.$description: Background surface tint for warning badges.

error.$description: Critical error and cancellation indicator (4.65:1 contrast, AA).

error-subtle.$description: Background surface tint for error and critical alerts.

info-subtle.$description: Background surface tint for informational chips.

2xs.$description: 2px - Micro padding, border offsets, hair-line gaps.

xs.$description: 4px - Tight badge padding, icon-to-label inline gaps.

sm.$description: 8px - Core component internal padding and compact item spacing.

md.$description: 12px - Medium component gap, chip padding, nested card margins.

lg.$description: 16px - Standard screen gutter, card inner padding, section spacing.

xl.$description: 24px - Large section spacing, hero banner padding.

2xl.$description: 32px - Major section division, modal top offset.

3xl.$description: 48px - Screen boundary padding, bottom sheet top header clearances.

sans.$value: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

display.$description: Prominent hero ETA timestamp ('12:45 PM') on Order Tracking screen.

heading-1.$description: Top-level page titles and showcase headers.

heading-2.$description: Section headers ('What are you craving?', 'Popular Near You').

heading-3.$description: Modal headers and promo card primary titles.

title.$description: Restaurant card titles, driver name, delivery address heading.

body.$description: Standard body copy, delivery instructions, subtitle explanations.

body-strong.$description: Emphasized body text, search field value, stepper current step label.

caption.$description: Metadata timestamps, distance badges, inactive stepper steps.

caption-strong.$description: Filter chip labels, active badges, rating scores.

overline.$description: Category tags, flash deal micro-chips, driver vehicle plate.

xs.$description: 4px - Micro badges, progress bar inner fills.

sm.$description: 8px - Small chips, nested media thumbnails, PIN digit tiles.

md.$description: 12px - Interactive action buttons, alert banners, category icons.

lg.$description: 16px - Standard restaurant cards, search container, promo banners.

xl.$description: 24px - Bottom sheet top corners, modal surfaces, floating sheets.

full.$description: 9999px - Pill chips, circular action buttons, avatar masks.

low.$description: Low elevation for filter chips and inline card boundaries.

medium.$description: Medium elevation for restaurant cards and floating map controls.

high.$description: High elevation for active floating order mini-bar and dialogs.

floating.$description: Brand-tinted floating shadow for primary action buttons.

sheet.$description: Top boundary shadow for interactive bottom sheets.

animationDurationSheet.$description: Bottom sheet tier snap animation duration.

sheetEasing.$description: Fluid spring curve for bottom sheet dragging and snapping.
